priority_policy.decision: Model quantization first. Training acceleration and training-memory optimization are later phases, not the current objective.

priority_policy.release_condition: Record a useful target model-quantization working point and explicitly move into training research before further training-state or speed optimization. A useful two-bit model is an acceptable interim; ternary remains the longer-term aim. Non-low-bit research stays on hold unless the owner reprioritizes.
priority_policy.not_required: Model quantization need not demonstrate accelerated training, perfected post-update repair, or every numerical array at the matrix-weight bitwidth. Preserve all historical failed gates and cost limits.
priority_policy.authorization: The user authorized the completed LB01-T3-TARGET model-quantization pass. No follow-on study or phase change is implied.
priority_policy.target: Ternary matrix symbols as longer-term aim; useful two-bit matrix weights acceptable interim. Wider scales, biases and execution state must be disclosed.
priority_policy.preparation_exception: Quantization-aware preparation may be used solely as a declared means of obtaining and validating the target low-bit model. Keep the preparation recipe fixed where possible, count its cost, and do not treat it as permission for a separate training-optimization study.

precision_direction.long_term_target: Ternary {-1,0,+1}, nominal log2(3)≈1.58bit matrix symbols plus declared overhead; not mandatory all-state precision.
precision_direction.core_distinction: Ternary forward weights do not inherently forbid learning or structural plasticity. Coarse update arithmetic can lose small changes; update state and serving values are distinct resources.
precision_direction.learning_goal: Deferred training phase: useful full-parameter learning with measured master/gradient/optimizer/activation costs and throughput. For the present model-quantization phase, only explicitly scoped preparation needed to produce/validate the low-bit model is eligible.
precision_direction.measured_precision: This pass: Q2 or T3 matrix codes, FP32 scales/biases, FP64 inference. Fixed FP32 masters/gradients/M32 moments used only for QAT preparation; no compression/acceleration intervention. Earlier M8/MASTER16 studies retained separately.
